title: Elf Bar Dual 10K Pineapple Edition Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Pineapple Edition Pre Filled Pods for the Elf Bar Dual 10K explore the tart, tropical side of fruit flavour. One pod blends Pineapple with an icy lift for a bright, cooling vape, while the other combines Pineapple with tangy Passionfruit for added depth and punch. Backed by the Dual 10K integrated refill system, each pod offers long-lasting flavour with no manual top-ups. Ideal for vapers who enjoy sharp tropical notes with a cool or exotic twist. How to Use: 1. Remove the Sticker and Read the Instructions 2. Remove the Silicone Parts and the Bottom Sticker 3. Press both containers securely into place 4. Install the pod into the Dual 10K device to use
